FK district_id -> districts.id ON DELETE CASCADE
One hour of recorded weather per district;
every forecast run tops this up (idempotent
upsert, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on the unique pair).

FK posted_by_id -> users.id ON DELETE SET NULL
author is a display-name snapshot (un-linked on purpose, survives
account deletion); posted_by_id is the real ownership link, used
for delete authorization and avatar lookup, and survives a rename.
Ephemeral: rows older than 24h are purged by the app.

FK user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE
Opaque bearer session token; the token itself
IS the primary key. Deleting the row = logout.
